moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-loading-typing-indicator, written here): Incoming bubble 82x40 r18 with a tail dot; three dots r5, 19 px apart. Each dot runs a 1.4 s cycle offset by 0.15 of a cycle per dot (210 ms; the caption says 150 ms): during the first 55 % of its cycle k = (0.5 − 0.5 cos(2π p / 0.55))^1.5, the dot crossfades grey → light by k and lifts 2 px × k; rest otherwise. An outgoing bubble above and an input bar below are static. Params: cycle (1.4 s) · offset (0.15 vòng) · lift (2 px) · brightness (xám → sáng). Each dot glows and lifts for the first 55 % of its cycle with k = (0.5 − 0.5 cos(2π p / 0.55))^1.5.
